recipes.title: Chargha
recipes.description: A legendary Lahori dish of whole roasted chicken marinated in traditional spices and deep-fried to golden perfection.
recipes.ingredients: 1 whole chicken (1.5 kg), 1 cup yogurt, 2 tbsp ginger-garlic paste, 2 tbsp red chili powder, 1 tbsp turmeric, 2 tbsp garam masala, 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tbsp coriander, 1 tbsp chaat masala, 2 tbsp lemon juice, Salt, 4 tbsp mustard oil, Oil for frying
recipes.instructions: Clean chicken and make deep cuts. Mix all marinade ingredients and apply generously. Refrigerate for 6 hours. Heat oil and deep fry chicken for 15-20 minutes until golden and crispy. Reduce heat and cook for another 10-15 minutes. Garnish with coriander, lemon wedges, and onion rings. Serve hot with naan.
recipes.about_dish: Signature dish of Lahore perfected at Gawalmandi food street.

recipes.title: Gol Gappay
recipes.description: Crispy hollow puris filled with spicy tangy water, chickpeas, and potatoes - Lahore's ultimate street food.
recipes.ingredients: For Puris: 1 cup semolina, 2 tbsp flour, 1/2 tsp baking soda, Salt, Oil. For Pani: Mint, coriander, green chilies, ginger, tamarind, chaat masala, black salt, cumin, water. For Filling: Chickpeas, potatoes, sprouts, onion, spices.
recipes.instructions: Make stiff dough with semolina and flour. Roll thin and cut into circles. Deep fry until puffed and golden. Blend all pani ingredients and strain. Mix filling ingredients. Make hole in puri, fill with mixture, dip in pani, top with sev. Eat immediately.
recipes.about_dish: Lahore's famous street food found at Anarkali and Liberty Market.

recipes.title: Butt Karahi
recipes.description: Lahore's famous chicken karahi cooked in a rich tomato-based gravy with ginger, garlic, and green chilies.
recipes.ingredients: 1 kg chicken, 1/2 cup ghee, 2 tbsp ginger paste, 2 tbsp garlic paste, 6 tomatoes pureed, 8 green chilies, 2 tbsp red chili powder, 1 tbsp coriander powder, 1 tbsp garam masala, 1 cup fresh coriander, Salt
recipes.instructions: Heat ghee in karahi. Add ginger-garlic paste and chicken. Cook until chicken changes color. Add tomato puree and spices. Cook on high heat until oil separates. Add green chilies and cook for 5 minutes. Sprinkle garam masala. Garnish with coriander and ginger. Serve with naan.
recipes.about_dish: Legendary dish from Lahore's famous Butt Karahi restaurant on Food Street.

recipes.title: Falooda
recipes.description: Beloved dessert drink combining rose syrup, vermicelli noodles, basil seeds, milk, and ice cream topped with nuts.
recipes.ingredients: 1 liter milk, 1/2 cup falooda sev, 3 tbsp basil seeds, 1/2 cup rose syrup, 1/4 cup sugar, 2 scoops vanilla ice cream, Almonds, pistachios, cashews
recipes.instructions: Soak basil seeds in water for 15 minutes. Cook falooda sev, drain and chill. In a glass, add rose syrup, basil seeds, and falooda noodles. Pour chilled milk. Add ice cream. Drizzle more rose syrup. Garnish with nuts. Serve immediately.
recipes.about_dish: Haji Sahab Falooda near Anarkali has been serving for over 80 years.

recipes.title: Fried Fish
recipes.description: Spicy tangy fried fish marinated in traditional spices and gram flour, deep-fried until golden and crispy.
recipes.ingredients: 1 kg fish fillets, 2 tbsp ginger-garlic, 2 tbsp red chili powder, 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tbsp coriander, 1 tbsp chaat masala, 3 tbsp lemon juice, 1/2 cup gram flour, 2 tbsp rice flour, Oil for frying
recipes.instructions: Marinate fish with all spices and lemon juice for 30 minutes. Add gram flour and rice flour. Coat well. Deep fry on medium heat until golden and crispy. Serve with mint chutney, onion rings, and lemon wedges.
recipes.about_dish: Anarkali Bazaar's famous fried fish stalls operating for decades.

recipes.title: Karachi Biryani
recipes.description: Fragrant spicy rice dish with chicken, potatoes, and Karachi's special spice blend.
recipes.ingredients: 1 kg chicken, 4 cups basmati rice, 1 cup yogurt, 2 tbsp ginger-garlic, 2 tbsp red chili powder, 2 tbsp biryani masala, 1/2 cup fried onions, 2 tomatoes, 2 potatoes, 1/2 cup oil
recipes.instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt and spices for 2 hours. Cook rice until 70% done. Cook chicken with tomatoes and potatoes until tender. Layer rice over chicken. Sprinkle fried onions, mint, coriander, ghee, and kewra. Cover and cook on low for 20-25 minutes. Serve with raita.
recipes.about_dish: Karachi's crown jewel - evolved from Hyderabadi biryani after 1947 partition.

recipes.title: Bun Kebab
recipes.description: Karachi's famous burger with spicy potato patty, mint chutney, and fresh vegetables.
recipes.ingredients: 4 potatoes, 1/2 cup peas, ginger-garlic paste, red chili powder, chaat masala, cumin, cornflour, Mint chutney, Burger buns, Onion, Tomato
recipes.instructions: Boil and mash potatoes. Mix with peas, spices, and cornflour. Shape into patties and shallow fry until golden. Blend chutney ingredients. Toast buns with butter. Spread chutney, place patty, add onions and tomatoes. Serve hot.
recipes.about_dish: Originated at Burns Road's Waheed Kabab House in the 1960s.

recipes.title: Haleem
recipes.description: Slow-cooked stew of meat, lentils, and wheat cooked for hours until creamy.
recipes.ingredients: 500g beef, 1 cup mixed lentils, 1/2 cup wheat, 1 cup yogurt, 2 tbsp ginger-garlic, 2 tbsp red chili powder, 1 tbsp garam masala, 1/2 cup oil, Fried onions
recipes.instructions: Soak lentils and wheat overnight. Pressure cook with meat until tender. Blend until smooth. Heat oil, add ginger-garlic. Add blended mixture and cook on low heat for 2-3 hours. Add yogurt and spices. Cook until oil separates. Garnish with fried onions.
recipes.about_dish: Burns Road Haleem sells over 500 kilos daily during Ramadan.

recipes.title: Burns Road Qeema
recipes.description: Spicy minced meat dish cooked with peas, tomatoes, and special spice blend.
recipes.ingredients: 500g beef mince, 1/2 cup oil, 2 onions, 2 tbsp ginger-garlic, 3 tomatoes pureed, 1/2 cup peas, 2 tbsp red chili powder, 1 tbsp garam masala
recipes.instructions: Heat oil and fry onions until golden. Add ginger-garlic and mince. Cook until mince changes color. Add tomato puree and spices. Cook until oil separates. Add peas and cook for 5 minutes. Add garam masala. Garnish with coriander. Serve with pav or naan.
recipes.about_dish: Burns Road's legendary breakfast qeema served for over 50 years.

recipes.title: Kulfi Falooda
recipes.description: Rich creamy frozen dessert with falooda noodles, rose syrup, and nuts.
recipes.ingredients: 1 liter milk, 1/2 cup khoya, 1/2 cup sugar, 1/4 cup milk powder, 1 tbsp cornflour, 1 tsp cardamom, 1/2 cup falooda sev, 2 tbsp basil seeds, 1/2 cup rose syrup
recipes.instructions: Boil milk and reduce to half. Add khoya, milk powder, and cornflour. Cook until thickened. Add sugar and cardamom. Freeze in molds. Cook falooda sev and soak basil seeds. Layer rose syrup, basil seeds, falooda, and kulfi. Garnish with nuts.
recipes.about_dish: Rehmat-e-Sherbet in Saddar serving since 1940.

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka
recipes.description: Famous grilled chicken tikka from Monal Restaurant marinated in cream and spices.
recipes.ingredients: 1 kg chicken thighs, 1 cup yogurt, 1/2 cup cream, 2 tbsp ginger-garlic, 2 tbsp red chili powder, 1 tbsp garam masala, 2 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tbsp chaat masala
recipes.instructions: Mix all marinade ingredients. Marinate chicken for 4-6 hours. Skewer and cook in tandoor or grill until charred. Sprinkle chaat masala. Serve with mint chutney and naan.
recipes.about_dish: Islamabad's most famous dining destination on Margalla Hills.

recipes.title: Shawarma
recipes.description: Islamabad's famous shawarma with tangy garlic sauce and perfectly roasted meat.
recipes.ingredients: 1 kg chicken, 1/2 cup yogurt, 1/4 cup vinegar, 2 tbsp shawarma spice, 4 tbsp garlic paste. For Garlic Sauce: 1 cup mayo, 2 tbsp garlic paste, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1/4 cup yogurt
recipes.instructions: Marinate meat overnight. Stack on vertical spit and roast slowly. Shave off thin slices as outer layer cooks. Mix garlic sauce ingredients. Serve wrapped in bread with garlic sauce, pickles, fries, and hot sauce.
recipes.about_dish: Savor Foods introduced this to Islamabad in the 1990s.

recipes.title: Trout Fish
recipes.description: Freshwater trout from Margalla Hills streams, grilled with herbs and lemon.
recipes.ingredients: 4 whole trout fish, 2 tbsp garlic paste, 2 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tbsp black pepper, 2 tbsp fresh dill, 2 tbsp parsley, 4 tbsp butter
recipes.instructions: Clean trout and make slits. Mix garlic paste, lemon juice, pepper, herbs, butter, and salt. Rub marinade all over fish. Wrap in foil with butter. Grill for 15-20 minutes, turning once. Serve hot with lemon wedges.
recipes.about_dish: Popular weekend activity for Islamabad residents.

recipes.title: Chapli Kebab
recipes.description: Thin crispy beef patty with pomegranate seeds - Peshawar style.
recipes.ingredients: 1 kg beef mince, 2 onions, 2 tomatoes, 1 cup coriander, 1/2 cup pomegranate seeds, 4 green chilies, 2 eggs, 1/2 cup cornflour, 2 tbsp red chili flakes
recipes.instructions: Mix all ingredients and rest for 30 minutes. Form into thin flat patties. Shallow fry on high heat for 3-4 minutes each side until very crispy. Serve with mint chutney, onion rings, and naan.
recipes.about_dish: Namak Mandi's famous chapli kebab for over 60 years.

recipes.title: Namak Mandi Karahi
recipes.description: Simple yet flavorful karahi from Peshawar's famous Namak Mandi using minimal spices and pure desi ghee.
recipes.ingredients: 1 kg mutton, 1 cup desi ghee, 4 tomatoes, 2 tbsp ginger paste, 2 tbsp garlic paste, 2 tbsp black pepper, 8 green chilies, Fresh coriander
recipes.instructions: Heat desi ghee in karahi. Add mutton and cook on high heat until brown. Add ginger-garlic paste. Add tomatoes and cook until soft. Add salt and half the black pepper. Cover and cook until meat is tender. Add remaining black pepper and green chilies. Garnish with coriander. Serve with naan.
recipes.about_dish: Historic salt market karahi shops operating for over a century.

recipes.title: Mutton Korma
recipes.description: Rich aromatic curry from Peshawar with mutton slow-cooked in yogurt, fried onions, and whole spices.
recipes.ingredients: 1 kg mutton, 2 cups yogurt, 3 fried onions, 2 tbsp ginger-garlic, 1 cup oil, 2 tbsp red chili powder, 1 tbsp garam masala, 1/2 cup almond paste, 1/2 cup khoya, Saffron
recipes.instructions: Blend fried onions with yogurt. Heat oil, add ginger-garlic and mutton. Brown the meat. Add onion-yogurt paste and spices. Cook on low heat until oil separates. Add water and simmer until mutton is tender. Add almond paste, khoya, and saffron. Sprinkle garam masala. Serve with naan.
recipes.about_dish: Known for rich nutty flavor from almond paste and khoya.

recipes.title: Lamb Sajji
recipes.description: Whole lamb leg marinated with salt and green papaya, slow-roasted over charcoal until smoky and tender.
recipes.ingredients: 1 whole lamb leg (3-4 kg), 1/2 cup salt, 1/4 cup green papaya paste, 2 tbsp black pepper, 1/4 cup vinegar, 4 cups basmati rice, Whole spices
recipes.instructions: Make deep slits in meat. Rub with salt, green papaya, black pepper, and vinegar. Marinate overnight. Skewer and roast over charcoal for 3-4 hours, turning every 30 minutes. Cook rice with spices and stuff inside lamb cavity. Serve with mint chutney.
recipes.about_dish: Sajji tradition dates back centuries to Silk Route caravanserais.

recipes.title: Sohan Halwa
recipes.description: Legendary sweet treat from Multan made from wheat starch, sugar, ghee, and nuts.
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup wheat starch, 2 cups sugar, 2 cups water, 1 cup ghee, 1/2 cup milk, 1/4 cup almonds, 1/4 cup pistachios, 1 tsp cardamom
recipes.instructions: Heat ghee in pan. Make sugar syrup separately. Add wheat starch to ghee, stirring continuously. Gradually add sugar syrup and milk. Cook until mixture thickens and leaves pan. Add cardamom and nuts. Pour into greased tray. Cool and cut into pieces.
recipes.about_dish: Made in Multan's Haram Gate area for over 200 years.

recipes.title: Mango Kulfi
recipes.description: Creamy frozen dessert made with fresh Multan mangoes known as the best in Pakistan.
recipes.ingredients: 2 cups fresh Multan mango pulp, 1 liter milk, 1/2 cup khoya, 1/2 cup sugar, 1/4 cup milk powder, 1 tbsp cornflour, 1 tsp cardamom, 1/4 cup pistachios
recipes.instructions: Boil milk and reduce to half. Add khoya, milk powder, and cornflour. Cook until thickened. Add sugar and cardamom. Cool completely. Fold in mango pulp and nuts. Pour into molds and freeze for 8 hours. Unmold and serve.
recipes.about_dish: Combines two of Multan's greatest treasures - Sohan Halwa and Chaunsa mangoes.

recipes.title: Channa Chaat
recipes.description: Spicy tangy chickpea chaat that's a street food favorite in Multan.
recipes.ingredients: 2 cups boiled chickpeas, 2 boiled potatoes, 1 onion, 2 tomatoes, 1/4 cup tamarind chutney, 2 tbsp mint chutney, 1 tbsp chaat masala, 1 tbsp pomegranate seeds
recipes.instructions: Mix chickpeas, potatoes, onion, and tomatoes. Add both chutneys and mix well. Sprinkle chaat masala, red chili powder, roasted cumin, and pomegranate seeds. Garnish with coriander and sev. Serve with poori.
recipes.about_dish: Ghanta Ghar's famous 'Pappu Chaat' operating since 1955.

recipes.title: Pati Gali Biryani
recipes.description: Unique biryani from Multan's famous Pati Gali with distinctive yellow color and local spices.
recipes.ingredients: 1 kg chicken, 4 cups basmati rice, 1 cup yogurt, 2 tbsp ginger-garlic, 2 tbsp yellow biryani masala, 1/2 cup milk with saffron, 2 tbsp kewra water, 1 cup fried onions
recipes.instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic, half biryani masala. Cook rice until 70% done. Layer chicken and rice in pot. Sprinkle remaining biryani masala, fried onions, saffron milk, and kewra water. Cook on low heat for 20 minutes. Serve with raita.
recipes.about_dish: Pati Gali has been home to biryani shops for over 150 years.

recipes.title: Sajji
recipes.description: Multan's version of Balochi classic with locally grown rice and unique spice blend.
recipes.ingredients: 1 whole baby lamb (5-6 kg), 1/2 cup salt, 1/4 cup Multani spice blend, 4 cups basmati rice, 1 cup oil, 2 onions, 2 tomatoes
recipes.instructions: Marinate lamb with salt and spice blend overnight. Prepare rice with onions, tomatoes, and whole spices until 70% done. Stuff rice into lamb's cavity and sew closed. Roast in tandoor for 4-5 hours. Serve with mint chutney.
recipes.about_dish: Famous for rice stuffed inside lamb absorbing all juices during roasting.

recipes.title: Sajji
recipes.description: Whole lamb marinated with salt and green papaya, slow-roasted over open fire until tender and smoky.
recipes.ingredients: 1 whole lamb leg (3-4 kg), 3 tbsp salt, 2 tbsp green papaya paste, 1 tbsp black pepper, 2 tbsp vinegar, 2 cups basmati rice
recipes.instructions: Make deep slits in meat. Rub with salt, green papaya, black pepper, and vinegar. Refrigerate overnight. Skewer and roast over charcoal for 2-3 hours, turning every 30 minutes. Serve with mint chutney and lemon wedges.
recipes.about_dish: Originated with Baloch nomads and perfected in Quetta.

recipes.title: Landhi
recipes.description: Traditional Balochi preserved meat where mutton is dried in sun and wind during winter.
recipes.ingredients: 2 kg mutton, 1/2 cup salt, 2 tbsp black pepper, 2 tbsp cumin crushed, 2 tbsp coriander crushed, 1 tbsp red chili flakes
recipes.instructions: Cut mutton into long thin strips. Mix spices and rub generously on meat. Hang strips in cool, dry, well-ventilated area for 20-30 days during winter. Meat becomes hard and dry. To cook, wash dried meat, boil until tender, cook with rice.
recipes.about_dish: Centuries-old preservation technique from Balochistan.

recipes.title: Channay
recipes.description: Fiery tangy chickpea curry that defines breakfast culture in Faisalabad.
recipes.ingredients: 2 cups chickpeas, 2 onions, 2 tomatoes, 2 tbsp ginger-garlic, 4 green chilies, 1/4 cup oil, 2 tbsp dried mango powder, 1 tbsp pomegranate seeds
recipes.instructions: Pressure cook chickpeas until soft. Heat oil, add cumin and onions. Fry until golden. Add ginger-garlic and tomato puree. Cook until oil separates. Add spices and chickpeas. Simmer for 20 minutes. Add dried mango powder and garam masala. Serve with poori.
recipes.about_dish: Originated from textile mill workers needing a hearty breakfast.

recipes.title: Murgh Cholay
recipes.description: Tender chicken with spicy chickpeas in rich tangy gravy - Rawalpindi style.
recipes.ingredients: 500g chicken, 2 cups chickpeas, 1 cup yogurt, 2 tbsp ginger-garlic, 2 tbsp Kashmiri red chili, 2 tbsp dried mango powder, 4 boiled eggs, 1/2 cup oil
recipes.instructions: Pressure cook chickpeas. Marinate chicken with yogurt and spices. Cook chicken until tender and shred. Prepare chickpea gravy with onions, tomatoes, and spices. Add shredded chicken and simmer. Add boiled eggs. Serve with naan.
recipes.about_dish: Allah Wala Murgh Cholay serving for over 50 years.

recipes.title: Channay
recipes.description: Legendary black chickpea dish from Rawalpindi's Kartarpura area.
recipes.ingredients: 2 cups black chickpeas, 2 onions, 2 tbsp ginger-garlic, 2 tomatoes, 1 tbsp dried ginger powder, 1 tsp asafoetida, 2 tbsp red chili powder
recipes.instructions: Soak black chickpeas overnight. Pressure cook until soft. Heat oil, add onion puree. Cook until golden. Add ginger-garlic, tomato puree, and spices. Cook until oil separates. Add chickpeas and simmer for 20 minutes. Serve with puri.
recipes.about_dish: Made the same way for over a century.

recipes.title: Kulfi Falooda
recipes.description: Sialkot's famous layered dessert with creamy kulfi and falooda.
recipes.ingredients: 1 liter milk, 1/2 cup khoya, 1/2 cup sugar, 1/4 cup milk powder, 1 tbsp cornflour, 1 tsp cardamom, 1/2 cup falooda sev, 2 tbsp basil seeds, 1/2 cup rose syrup
recipes.instructions: Boil milk and reduce to half. Add khoya, milk powder, and cornflour. Cook until thickened. Add sugar and cardamom. Freeze in molds. Cook falooda sev and soak basil seeds. Layer rose syrup, basil seeds, falooda, and kulfi. Garnish with nuts.
recipes.about_dish: Shezan Ice Cream parlor serving since 1956.

recipes.title: Gola Ganda Kala Khatta
recipes.description: Sialkot's signature shaved ice dessert with black plum syrup.
recipes.ingredients: Ice block, 1 cup Kala Khatta syrup, 1/2 cup sugar, 1/2 cup water, 1 tsp black salt, 1 tsp chaat masala
recipes.instructions: Boil black plums with water, sugar, and black salt. Reduce and strain. Shave ice and pack into cup. Pour Kala Khatta syrup. Sprinkle chaat masala. Serve immediately.
recipes.about_dish: Unique to Sialkot using locally grown black plums.

recipes.title: Chicken Pulao
recipes.description: Fragrant rice dish with tender chicken and aromatic whole spices.
recipes.ingredients: 1 kg chicken, 4 cups basmati rice, 2 onions, 2 tbsp ginger-garlic, 1 cup yogurt, 2 tbsp red chili powder, 1/2 cup oil, Whole spices
recipes.instructions: Heat oil and fry onions until golden. Add chicken and ginger-garlic. Cook until brown. Add yogurt and spices. Add water and whole spices. When water boils, add soaked rice. Cook on high until water absorbs, then cover and cook on low for 15 minutes.
recipes.about_dish: Wedding staple cooked in massive degs over wood fires.

recipes.title: Samosa Chaat
recipes.description: Delicious chaat with crushed samosas, chickpeas, yogurt, and chutneys.
recipes.ingredients: 6 samosas, 1 cup chickpeas, 1 cup yogurt, 1/2 cup tamarind chutney, 1/2 cup mint chutney, 1/4 cup chaat masala, 1 onion, Sev
recipes.instructions: Crush samosas into bite-sized pieces. Add boiled chickpeas. Pour beaten yogurt. Add both chutneys. Sprinkle chaat masala. Add chopped onion. Mix gently. Garnish with coriander and sev. Serve immediately.
recipes.about_dish: Best found near clock tower in Sialkot's old city.

recipes.title: Bhugga
recipes.description: Flavorful Sindhi dish of goat meat and spinach slow-cooked with traditional spices.
recipes.ingredients: 500g goat meat, 2 cups spinach pureed, 2 onions, 2 tomatoes, 2 tbsp ginger-garlic, 2 tbsp red chili powder, 1 tbsp garam masala, 1/2 cup oil
recipes.instructions: Heat oil and fry onions until golden. Add ginger-garlic and meat. Cook until meat browns. Add tomato puree and spices. Cook until oil separates. Add spinach puree and water. Cook on low heat until meat is tender. Add garam masala. Serve with rice.
recipes.about_dish: Traditional Sindhi dish from Hyderabad's old city.

recipes.title: Sindhi Kadi Chawal
recipes.description: Tangy gram flour curry with vegetables served over steamed rice.
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup gram flour, 2 cups yogurt, 6 cups water, 2 onions, 2 tbsp ginger-garlic, 2 tbsp red chili powder, 1 tsp turmeric, Vegetables
recipes.instructions: Mix gram flour with yogurt and water. Heat oil, fry onions until golden. Add ginger-garlic and vegetables. Add gram flour mixture and spices. Simmer for 45 minutes. Prepare tadka with ghee, cumin, mustard seeds. Pour over kadi. Serve with rice.
recipes.about_dish: Connects Sindhis worldwide to their roots.

recipes.title: Pappu Masala
recipes.description: Spicy lentil dish with toor dal, garlic, tomatoes, and generous ghee.
recipes.ingredients: 2 cups toor dal, 1 onion, 2 tomatoes, 2 tbsp ginger-garlic, 2 tbsp red chili powder, 1/2 cup ghee, 1 lemon
recipes.instructions: Pressure cook dal with turmeric until soft. Heat ghee, add onion. Fry until golden. Add ginger-garlic and tomatoes. Add spices. Add cooked dal and simmer for 10 minutes. Add lemon juice. Serve with rice or roti.
recipes.about_dish: Quintessential Sindhi breakfast - every family has their own variation.

recipes.title: Double Roti
recipes.description: Hyderabad's unique pressed sandwich with spicy potato filling and chutneys.
recipes.ingredients: 4 potatoes, 1 onion, 2 green chilies, chaat masala, Mint chutney, Tamarind chutney, Garlic chutney, White bread, Butter
recipes.instructions: Mix mashed potatoes with spices. Toast bread slices with butter until golden. Spread chutneys on bread. Place potato filling on one slice. Top with onion and tomato. Cover with second slice. Press and toast until crispy. Serve hot.
recipes.about_dish: Legacy of British influence on Sindhi cuisine.
